## Change

State the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Refs #<number>` when a separate deployment is needed.

## Sources and rights

Link authoritative sources and state any content or data rights that affect this change. Do not paste private inputs.

## Verification

Link the hosted checks and independent review evidence. For publication, record the intended public URL and the checks still needed after deployment.

## Test changes

List any changed tests and the reason, or state that no tests changed.
